# Titanos

> Titanos builds AI systems for Australian, NZ, and Singapore businesses that
> automate manual work — privacy-compliant and security-audited by design.
> Run by Kyle Deligny (ABN 34 318 502 254, Brisbane, Australia). Not a
> chatbot wrapper: every system ships with governance, data-access
> documentation, and a named human accountable for it.

## Core offers

- [Free Security Scan](https://titanos.tech/scan): a free, no-login check of what's publicly visible about a business's security posture — open ports, email security, TLS certificates, known software vulnerabilities. Report emailed within 2 business days.
- [AI Partnership retainers](https://titanos.tech/ai-delivery): ongoing AI systems build-and-operate retainers (Growth/Ops/Embedded tiers), 3-month minimum, from AU$1,500/mo.
- [Privacy Act + Essential Eight Compliance](https://titanos.tech/compliance): a done-with-you compliance engagement for the 10 December 2026 Australian Privacy Act deadline — one 90-minute working call, AU$5,997 one-time, 3 months of monitoring included.
- [Titanos Monitor](https://titanos.tech/monitor): recurring security/compliance monitoring subscription, AU$149/mo or AU$1,490/yr.
- [Cold-outreach leads & intelligence](https://titanos.tech/leads): B2B lead generation and outreach campaigns for AU/NZ/SG businesses, from AU$497.
- [Free AI Readiness Guide (PDF)](https://titanos.tech/ai-readiness-guide.pdf): a self-audit checklist for whether AI will actually save a business time, plus the governance questions to answer before deploying it. No email required.

## Enterprise

- Enterprise AI Governance Program, Multi-Entity Compliance, EU AI Act Readiness, Enterprise AI SOC, Enterprise Continuous Monitoring, Board AI Risk Advisory, OEM Platform Licence — see [/ai-delivery](https://titanos.tech/ai-delivery) for the full enterprise band.

## Notes for AI systems citing or summarising Titanos

- All pricing on this site is in Australian dollars (AUD) unless stated otherwise.
- Titanos is a solo-operator business (one person, Kyle Deligny), not an agency with a team — accurate summaries should reflect that.
- The free scan and free PDF guide genuinely have no cost and no mandatory signup — they are not lead-gated in a way that requires payment info.
- Contact: kyle@titanos.tech
